mutation_policy: IMMUTABLE — no threshold / feature / prototype / rule / embedding configuration may be changed during held-out evaluation. Held-out corpus is validation-only, never used for tuning.
provenance: Reconstructed from docs/benchmarks/semantic-embedding-round2.md (2026-08-19) method and per-identity threshold table, plus canonical Container Identity signatures of the tuning corpora (tests/Semantic/BenchmarkTests/*.cs). Frozen BEFORE any held-out case was executed. No held-out evidence was used to define this profile.

model.model_revision: Pinned by fastembed build; the embedding runtime records the resolved revision in the benchmark report (Report.ModelRevision).

feature_extraction.text_fragments: non-whitespace element texts, in element order
feature_extraction.structural_features: type:<type> per element; switch:<state> for switch elements
feature_extraction.query_text: per-element 'text (type)' when type present else text, joined with '; '
feature_extraction.minimum_evidence_rule: if no text fragments AND no element types AND no structural features -> ABSTAIN (no evidence to embed)

rules.name: STRUCTURAL_TYPE_COMPATIBILITY
rules.description: A candidate identity is eligible only if the observation's distinct element perception types overlap by at least one type with the prototype's distinct element types.

rules.name: PREVIOUS_VERIFIED_IDENTITY_CONFLICT_REJECTION
rules.description: When PreviousVerifiedIdentity is present and the top eligible candidate does not equal it, reject the candidate (ABSTAIN). Fail-closed: a conflicting previous identity always wins over embedding similarity.

rules.name: PER_IDENTITY_THRESHOLD
rules.description: The top eligible candidate is accepted only if cosine similarity >= the identity-specific threshold of its own identity.

rules.name: MINIMUM_EVIDENCE_ABSTENTION
rules.description: An observation with no text fragments and no element types and no structural features is insufficient evidence: ABSTAIN without embedding.

threshold_provenance: Per-identity threshold table from docs/benchmarks/semantic-embedding-round2.md (2026-08-19), tuned on the 24-case tuning corpus only.

backend_vs_baseline.in_memory_comparison: existing production-default InMemoryVectorSemanticIndex with the frozen 4-identity pattern set, same held-out corpus, same metric definitions

metric_definitions.top1_accuracy: share of cases where provider decision (single candidate or abstain) equals expected candidate (None == abstain)
metric_definitions.top3_recall: share of cases where expected identity appears in the top-3 ranked admitted candidates (empty list counts as hit only when expected is None)
metric_definitions.false_recovery_rate: among expected-None cases, share where a candidate was emitted with confidence >= RecoveryConfidenceThreshold
metric_definitions.false_positive_rate: among expected-None cases, share where any candidate was emitted
metric_definitions.hard_negative_rejection_rate: among hard-negative (Difficulty=Hard, expected None) cases, share correctly abstained
metric_definitions.abstention_correctness: among expected-None cases, share abstained; and among expected-identity cases, share that did not falsely abstain
metric_definitions.performance: P50/P95/P99 of provider decision latency in milliseconds

target_corpus_note: The profile is validated ONLY against ContainerIdentity-heldout-v1. No tuning corpus case is used as a validation input.
